core_obligations: Reduce to a comparison: two surjections from polynomial rings give a common larger polynomial ring mapping to the algebra, and by symmetry it suffices to compare the functors attached to a presentation and to its extension by one variable (proof lines 4588-4599)
Induct on the number of variables, reducing to the case of a single added variable (proof lines 4599-4601)

Single variable case: write the extension as a composite with the projection sending the new variable to an element, transpose along the composite of the two right adjoints and apply the computation for a single variable (proof lines 4602-4625)
proof_roadmap: 两个多项式环的满射给出共同的大多项式环 → A 的交换图；由对称性只需比较「P → A」与「P[y_1,…,y_m] → A」两个展示的函子。
单变量：χ : Q = P[y] → A 诱导 ψ : P → A，取 g ∈ P 使 χ(y) = ψ(g)，令 π : Q → P 为 y ↦ g；则 χ = ψ∘π ⇒ χ^! = ψ^!∘π^!（两者都是限制函子的右伴随）；把问题化为 π^!(-) ≅ (-)⊗_Q^L P[-1]，由单变量计算引理即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the functor constructed from a presentation of an algebra does not depend on the chosen presentation (author lemma at source lines 4581-4586, label lemma-well-defined). The proof (source lines 4588-4626) reduces the comparison to the case of extending a presentation by one variable, transposes the resulting composite of right adjoints and invokes the single-variable computation (proof lines 4588-4625). The adjoint bookkeeping and the single-variable reduction are the substance. H3.
